decisions.subject: Production Pipeline

options_considered.label: animated-explainer
options_considered.reason: 完美支援 course_form 學習架構、course_manifest 結構化教學單元及前置 Research/Proposal 流程

options_considered.label: cinematic
options_considered.reason: 偏向短片視覺氛圍，缺乏完整的課程微課單元組織能力
options_considered.rejected_because: 不符合企業內訓課程微課與學習評量結構需求

decisions.reason: 選擇 animated-explainer 搭配 content_form='course_form' 作為課程生產專用管線

decisions.subject: Composition Render Engine

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: 本地已驗證可用 (doctor passed)，擅長動態排版、幾何插畫與微動畫，與 Atelier 模式高度契合

options_considered.label: Remotion (React Scene Stack)
options_considered.reason: 環境中未安裝 node_modules，套件解析超時無法執行
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine

options_considered.label: FFmpeg Direct Stitch
options_considered.reason: 作為最後降級備案，但缺乏豐富的前端動態表現力
options_considered.rejected_because: 無法呈現細緻的情境劇動態文字與分鏡轉場

decisions.reason: Remotion 在本環境未安裝，HyperFrames 本地驗證完全就緒且具備優秀的動態表現力

decisions.subject: Authoring Mode (Atelier vs Templated)

options_considered.label: Atelier (匠意手作模式)
options_considered.reason: 針對鴻海品牌特色量身訂製專屬色彩、字體與情境舞台，維繫沉浸感

options_considered.label: Templated (模板拼裝模式)
options_considered.reason: 依賴 Remotion 預設 scene components，但在 HyperFrames 下無法套用現成公版
options_considered.rejected_because: 受限於 Remotion 依賴且風格較為刻板公版

decisions.reason: 推薦 Atelier 模式，為企業集團核心價值形象大作打造專屬視覺語言

decisions.subject: TTS & Media Generation Providers

options_considered.label: Google AI APIs (Google TTS + Google Imagen)
options_considered.reason: 已完成配置且具備中文台灣語音合成能力，預估成本為 0.00 USD

options_considered.label: ElevenLabs & fal.ai Seedance 2.0
options_considered.reason: 需外部付費 API 授權，受限於未事先核准原則
options_considered.rejected_because: 本案堅持零付費呼叫原則，待樣品批准後方可評估

decisions.reason: 遵循零未授權付費原則，優先使用已配置之 Google 憑證與本地渲染引擎

decisions.subject: Character CLP Policy

options_considered.label: Strict Reference (9 master reference images)
options_considered.reason: User provided 9 character master reference images from HH_chacter.md to enforce exact facial, costume, and style consistency across all shots.

options_considered.label: Text Anchor Only
options_considered.reason: Text-only prompts result in face and clothing drift across shots.
options_considered.rejected_because: Does not meet corporate quality bar for character consistency.

decisions.reason: Strict Reference binding ensures zero drift across 40 minutes of course footage.

decisions.subject: Production Style Playbook

options_considered.label: 3D Pixar Animation Style (esg-pixar-hybrid)
options_considered.reason: Bound project to 3D Pixar Animation style as instructed by Director, ensuring Pixar shaders and character consistency.

options_considered.label: Clean Professional Flat Vector
options_considered.reason: Clean professional style lacks 3D depth and emotional engagement.

decisions.reason: Director selected 3D Pixar animation style for emotional resonance and corporate prestige.

decisions.subject: Character Visual Prompt & Reference Image Alignment

options_considered.label: Exact Design Sheet Alignment
options_considered.reason: Aligned all 9 character prompt anchors, visual traits, and costumes to verbatim match 鴻海人物SS圖prompt.docx and master reference JPEGs.

options_considered.label: Generic Corporate Character Prompts
options_considered.reason: Generic descriptions do not match the approved design sheet details.
options_considered.rejected_because: Violates explicit costume and facial trait specifications.

decisions.reason: Ensures prompt anchors match the exact design sheets and ingested reference assets.

decisions.subject: Location CLP Policy & Reference Image Ingestion

options_considered.label: Strict Reference with local CAS-verified empty plates (5504x3072)
options_considered.reason: User provided 7 high-resolution 5504x3072 empty plate location master images in HH_chacter.md. All 7 locations ingested with CAS SHA-256 digests.

options_considered.label: Text Anchor Only
options_considered.reason: Generates random office layouts without spatial consistency.
options_considered.rejected_because: Fails location continuity requirements across units.

decisions.reason: Ingested 7 high-res empty plates with SHA-256 digests to lock background layouts.

decisions.subject: Composition Render Engine

options_considered.label: Remotion & FFmpeg Video-First Composition
options_considered.reason: Video-first assembly for Veo/Omni clips with automated audio replacement, speech duration conform, side-panel overlay, and caption burning.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP Foreground Render)
options_considered.reason: HyperFrames code-rendered foreground would break character appearance and visual continuity with prequel course.
options_considered.rejected_because: User explicitly excluded HyperFrames in foreground to maintain realistic visual continuity with prequel course.

decisions.reason: User explicitly decided against foreground HyperFrames; video-led pipeline with Remotion/FFmpeg handles clip stitching, TTS dubbing, and layout overlays.

decisions.subject: Amy Presenter Generation & Audio Dubbing Policy

options_considered.label: First-Last Frame Chaining with Chinese Dialogue Prompt & TTS Dubbing
options_considered.reason: First-to-last frame chaining ensures zero jump cuts; Chinese dialogue prompt ensures natural Chinese lip motion; assembly dubbing with Google TTS ensures pristine enterprise audio.

options_considered.label: Independent Video Clip Generations
options_considered.reason: Generating separate clips causes severe character drift, clothing shifts, and jarring jump cuts between shots.
options_considered.rejected_because: Fails character continuity and creates visual glitches between cuts.

decisions.reason: Eliminates jump cuts between presenter clips, achieves authentic Chinese lip cadence, and guarantees crystal-clear enterprise audio.

decisions.subject: Dual-Track Production Policy (Spokesperson vs Cinematic Drama)

options_considered.label: Dual-Track Hybrid: Spokesperson for Intro/Bridge/Outro, Cinematic Drama for Neg/Pos
options_considered.reason: Intro, bridge, and outro use Amy spokesperson setup (chained video + side-panel instructional cards); Neg (dilemma) and Pos (solution) use Cinematic 5-Aspect multi-character workplace drama with concrete physical action sequences.

options_considered.label: Uniform Explainer Slides for All Scenes
options_considered.reason: Treating neg/pos scenes as generic explainer slides ignores emotional workplace conflict and weakens behavioral impact.
options_considered.rejected_because: Office workplace dilemmas cannot be effectively delivered through talking head or static cards alone; requires cinematic dramatic tension.

options_considered.label: Pure Cinematic for All Scenes
options_considered.reason: Applying cinematic multi-shot drama to introductory lecturing adds unnecessary complexity and lacks direct instructional clarity.
options_considered.rejected_because: Course structure requires a dedicated instructor anchor to deliver structured learning objectives.

decisions.reason: Optimal pedagogical architecture: Amy anchors instructional intent, while cinematic drama vividly illustrates complex workplace dilemmas and correct behavioral solutions.
